title: ingestion segment_and_embed response, v0
description: 200 answer of segment_and_embed. Segments are listed in reading order; the core numbers them in that order.

part_key.description: Key of the request Part the segment is cut from.

start.description: First Unicode code point of the segment in the Part text.

end.description: Code point after the last one. start = end is an empty segment, allowed only when the request has a Part with the role title: the segment then stands for the title alone.

part_key.description: Key of a request Part contributing one source slice.

start.description: First Unicode code point of the source slice in the Part text.

end.description: Code point after the last one in the source slice; each source range spans at most 4096 code points.

source_ranges.description: Optional ordered non-empty source slices for a segment spanning Parts. The first range must equal the legacy part_key/start/end anchor; each range is at most 4096 code points and the joined slices plus separators are at most 16384 code points.

source_separator.description: Optional Unicode separator used between source ranges when constructing the packed passage. Missing and empty separators are equivalent.

additionalProperties.description: One vector, exactly as many numbers as the space's dimensions. Values must be finite as 32-bit floats; under the cosine metric the vector must not be all zeros.

vectors.description: One vector per requested space, by space id; empty when the request asks for no space (since Plugin API 0.8).

lexical_text.description: Optional keyword-search text for the segment (for example lower-cased, folded or stemmed words). The core indexes it in a separate keyword field; excerpts always come from the source text. At most 16384 code points, no NUL.

provenance.description: Optional details of how the segment was made (token counts, the embedded text's template), at most 4 KiB once serialized. Stored with the segmentation, never interpreted.

next_start.description: Since Plugin API 0.18, only for paged requests. First unprocessed source code point. Omitted only when all source text through the end of the request Part is covered.
